fields.description: Shiprocket has no separate sandbox host: a test account uses the same API. This flag only records which account is in use.
fields.label: Test Mode

fields.description: The Shiprocket API user's email. Create a dedicated API user under Settings > API in the Shiprocket panel; a normal login will not authenticate here.
fields.label: Email

fields.description: The pickup location nickname exactly as registered in the Shiprocket panel. Shiprocket will not accept an address pushed from here; it only accepts a nickname it already knows.
fields.label: Pickup Location Nickname

fields.description: The same location as an ERPNext Address. Its pincode is the origin used when quoting rates.
fields.label: Pickup Address

fields.description: Optional Shiprocket channel id. Leave blank to use the account's default channel.
fields.label: Channel ID

fields.description: Shiprocket bills in INR only; this is the currency its quoted rates are read as.
fields.label: Currency

fields.description: Volumetric weight divisor for cm/kg. 5000 is the standard domestic figure; change it only if your Shiprocket contract says otherwise.
fields.label: Volumetric Divisor

fields.description: How long a checkout rate call may take before the option falls back to its backup price. Checkout must never hang on a carrier.
fields.label: Rates Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Shiprocket does not sign its webhooks. It sends back whatever token you set as the x-api-key in its webhook configuration, so paste the same value here — without it, anyone could post a delivery status for any order.
fields.label: Webhook Token (x-api-key)
